# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We want Cadence to be a welcoming, harassment-free project for everyone, regardless of background, identity or experience level.

This project adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/) as its code of conduct.

## In short

- Be respectful and assume good intent.
- Give and take constructive feedback gracefully.
- Focus on what's best for the project and its users.
- No harassment, insults, personal attacks, trolling, or sharing others' private information.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit, hide or remove comments, commits, code, issues and other contributions that don't follow this code, and may temporarily or permanently block anyone whose behavior is harmful.

To report a problem, use GitHub's **Report content** option on the comment or issue, or contact the maintainer ([@kilwizac](https://github.com/kilwizac)) privately. All reports will be reviewed promptly and kept confidential.
